However, the reference contains eight labels, including Pre-B_cell_CD34-, CMP, and Pro-B_cell_CD34+, whereas the candidate uses only five broader labels and absorbs those minor populations into Monocyte, T_cells, or B_cell. There are also scattered per-cell color differences near population boundaries. Titles, axis capitalization, colors, fonts, and legend placement differ but are not scientifically critical. The matching layout and major identities support substantial equivalence, while the loss of finer annotations makes the images only partially equivalent.
